label: Men's ODI
methodology: The 100 most recent eligible international matches in the downloaded archive. First innings only, replayed at completed-over checkpoints using only deliveries available at that checkpoint. Full-length six-ball-over matches, including all-out innings that reached all checkpoints; rain-adjusted and no-result matches excluded. Historical replay of the current model, not an out-of-time training holdout. Existing model priors and learned adjustments may incorporate historical information. Eligibility favours longer innings; this is not a random sample of all matches.
summary: Across 400 predictions the model has an MAE of 46.5 runs and RMSE of 58.7 runs. Bias is -25.5 runs (the model undershoots on average). The predicted range captures the actual score 27.3% of the time with an average range width of 46 runs. Error by final score bucket: low-scoring (<160): 25.9 runs MAE, mid-range (160–200): 29.0 runs MAE, high-scoring (200+): 49.9 runs MAE. Predictions are least accurate at the 10-over checkpoint (MAE 62.8 runs) and most accurate at 40 overs (MAE 29.6 runs).
